description: This file defines a mock class for the IMediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService interface used in IPC communication within the Rialto server component. It uses Google Mock to facilitate unit testing of components that depend on this interface.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleServiceMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IMediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService interface for testing purposes.
